svg.aria-label: Animation: messages are appended to the conversation log; after a turn the older 24 are summarized in the background while the 8 most recent stay verbatim; the log keeps growing, and the model context holds the summary plus recent messages.

g.text: summarized in the background, after the turn
Every message is appended to the conversation log, and the model sees all of it.
After a turn, older messages are summarized in the background. The 8 most recent stay verbatim.
The log is never rewritten. Later turns build on the summary plus the recent messages.
